# CreateAudioBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CreateAudioBus:Int32 parent:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parent` | In | Int32 | `0` | The bus that this one feeds, `0` (the default) for the master bus. |

**Returns:** The handle of the bus. It works without a sound device too.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes a bus: a group of channels with its own volume and pause state, that feeds another bus. Everything plays on the master bus (`0`) until it is put on another one, so a game can turn the world down for a pause menu and leave the music alone. See [Audio buses](Audio-Buses). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
world = CreateAudioBus()
music = CreateAudioBus()
MusicBus music
; The pause menu: the world fades out, the music plays on.
AudioBusVolume world, 0, 300
```
